Leave fields empty for automatic detection. Min duration and max gap apply with a threshold; the under threshold always applies. The result is not stored.
No structured interval set detected – the efforts were too irregular to be planned repeats (e.g. traffic lights or climbs).

From laps: the laps of a structured workout or lap button presses mark the intervals; in a structured workout the step type (work / rest) decides which laps are intervals. From power: the intervals are detected from the power data. The choice is saved for this ride.

Fill in a name and a weight between 20 and 250 kg (resting HR 25–120 bpm).
E.g. after an FTP test. Rides of the last 42 days are recalculated at once, older ones when opened; empty fields keep their previous value.
Check the values: FTP 30–2500 W, LTHR 60–230 bpm, max HR 80–240 bpm, a day until today.
There already are thresholds valid from this day.

LTHR is optional. If you don\'t know it, enter your max heart rate – heart rate zones are then derived from it. LTHR gives more accurate zones and is needed for training stress from heart rate (hrTSS) on rides without power.
No thresholds yet – add your FTP, LTHR and max HR.

Connect your intervals.icu account to import rides with one tap – from any device (Garmin, Wahoo, Zwift, COROS…).
You find the API key and the athlete id in intervals.icu → Settings → Developer Settings. The athlete id is optional – without it, the owner of the key is used.

This cannot be undone. We delete the account and all your data; it disappears from the backups within 14 days. If you want to keep your files, download them first.
